outcome: the task's own tests/test.sh after the agent exited: reward.txt 1 = resolved

steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
cat /workspace/my-sql-query.sql
echo "---SCHEMA---"
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite ".schema"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "SELECT name,type,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';"
echo "---COUNTS---"
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "SELECT 'words',COUNT(*) FROM words UNION ALL SELECT 'senses',COUNT(*) FROM senses UNION ALL SELECT 'synsets',COUNT(*) FROM synsets;"
echo "---SQLITE VER---"
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "select sqlite_version();"
echo "---PLAN---"
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat /workspace/my-sql-query.sql)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN synsets sy ON s.synsetid=sy.synsetid WHERE sy.synsetid IS NULL) AS bad_synset, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN words w ON s.wordid=w.wordid WHERE w.wordid IS NULL) AS bad_word, (SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT wordid) FROM words) AS dup_words, (SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT synsetid) FROM synsets) AS dup_synsets, (SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT wordid||','||synsetid) FROM senses) AS dup_sense_pairs;"
echo "---dist of senses per pair---"
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "SELECT num, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) num FROM senses GROUP BY wordid,synsetid) GROUP BY num;"
echo "---candidate count---"
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT w.wordid FROM words w JOIN senses s ON w.wordid=s.wordid JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid=syn.synsetid GROUP BY w.wordid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid)>=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid)>=2 AND COUNT(*)>=2);"
echo "---timing original (limit maybe)---"
time sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "$(cat /workspace/my-sql-query.sql)" > /tmp/orig.txt
wc -l /tmp/orig.txt
head -5 /tmp/orig.txt
EOF

sbx put /workspace/sol_test.sql <<'EOF'
WITH pair AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses
  GROUP BY wordid, synsetid
),
wagg AS (
  SELECT p.wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(p.cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sy.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sy.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM pair p
  JOIN synsets sy ON sy.synsetid = p.synsetid
  GROUP BY p.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT sy.domainid) >= 2
     AND SUM(p.cnt) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.wordid, p.synsetid, p.cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.wordid ORDER BY p.cnt DESC, p.synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM pair p
  JOIN wagg a ON a.wordid = p.wordid
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       a.total_synsets,
       a.total_senses,
       a.distinct_domains,
       a.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM wagg a
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = a.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY a.total_senses DESC,
         a.total_synsets DESC,
         a.distinct_domains DESC,
         a.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
sbx run <<'EOF'
echo "---plan---"
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat /workspace/sol_test.sql)"
echo "---run---"
time sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "$(cat /workspace/sol_test.sql)" > /tmp/new.txt
wc -l /tmp/new.txt
head -5 /tmp/new.txt
echo "---diff---"
diff /tmp/orig.txt /tmp/new.txt | head -40
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "$(cat /workspace/my-sql-query.sql)" > /tmp/orig.txt
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "$(cat /workspace/sol_test.sql)" > /tmp/new.txt
if diff -q /tmp/orig.txt /tmp/new.txt; then echo IDENTICAL; else echo DIFFERENT; diff /tmp/orig.txt /tmp/new.txt | head -40; fi
EOF

sbx put /workspace/sol.sql <<'EOF'
WITH pair AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses
  GROUP BY wordid, synsetid
),
wagg AS (
  SELECT p.wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(p.cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sy.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sy.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM pair p
  JOIN synsets sy ON sy.synsetid = p.synsetid
  GROUP BY p.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT sy.domainid) >= 2
     AND SUM(p.cnt) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.wordid, p.synsetid, p.cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.wordid ORDER BY p.cnt DESC, p.synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM pair p
  JOIN wagg a ON a.wordid = p.wordid
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       a.total_synsets,
       a.total_senses,
       a.distinct_domains,
       a.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM wagg a
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = a.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY a.total_senses DESC,
         a.total_synsets DESC,
         a.distinct_domains DESC,
         a.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
sbx run <<'EOF'
sqlite3 /workspace/oewn.sqlite "$(cat /workspace/sol.sql)" | head -3
EOF
